verdict.rationale: Zep's Graphiti-based Context Graph uses a bi-temporal model with 'fact invalidation' so contradicted or outdated facts are marked as no longer current (zep-docs-52, zep-gh-1/2/3), which addresses the 'stale facts stop surfacing' goal, but there is no documented TTL setting, explicit expiration timestamps, or recency-weighted ranking in search (only semantic+BM25 hybrid search per zep-docs-9/22). Missing for 10: explicit TTL/expiration-date API, recency weighting in retrieval scoring, and documentation describing decay mechanics beyond contradiction-based invalidation.
